description: Hospital bill contains explicitly excluded non-payable items: admission processing charges (INR 1200) and luxury patient amenity kits (INR 1800), totaling INR 3000.

source.quote: Non-medical sundries: Admission processing charges INR 1200.00, Luxury patient amenity kits INR 1800.00.

calculation_steps: Identified invoiced line items matching Section 3.2 non-payable schedule: admission processing charges and luxury patient amenity kits.
Summed non-payable amounts: INR 1200 + INR 1800 = INR 3000.00 non-payable deduction.
expected_findings.explanation: Invoiced expenses include admission processing charges (INR 1200) and luxury patient amenity kits (INR 1800), which are explicitly non-payable under Section 3.2.

source.quote: Section 3.2 (Non-Payable Items Schedule): The following non-medical and administrative items are non-payable and strictly excluded from reimbursement: registration fees, admission processing charges, gloves, face masks, sanitizers, thermometer charges, and luxury patient amenity kits.
